title: MOIRAI L3: array-level versus per-trace P/S phase picking on real downhole 3-C arrays (AMBER)
description: Code, EMA-best model weights and reproducible figure/table scripts accompanying the paper 'When does array moveout help borehole phase picking?' (Kurosawa; submitted to Geophysical Journal International). A geometry-invariant 2-D U-Net is trained under a strict leave-one-site-out protocol on the AMBER benchmark and evaluated zero-shot on the held-out site, in array vs per-trace configurations that differ only in whether cross-station moveout is available, with a station-shuffle control. This version adds the second-round revision analyses (scripts 15-25): phase confusion, the physical audit of the catalogued arrivals, array geometry and source-receiver distances, identical-input evaluation, model capacity, the within-array experiment, event accounting, native sampling rates, the supplementary diagnosis panels, moveout distributions, and the assembly of the Supporting Information document.
notes: AMBER benchmark data (Verdon et al. 2026) are not redistributed here and must be obtained from their own archive. The preprint (Author's Original Version) is on EarthArXiv, doi:10.31223/X5121S.
